Moss's 30 September digest says Mateo Quiroga submitted ticket **#8841** for Vantorre Group. Drivers on the second shift at Newark can't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk, and the digest says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Before you send the engineering follow-up, check the number. In #strategic-pod on 1 July you wrote that you closed out #8841 with support, about kiosk tablet browser cache issues at Allentown. Either that's a different issue reusing the number, or the reference is stale. Confirm #8841 is still the open Door 14 ticket.
